summary: JATT III Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on August 27, 2026. The company sold 6,900,000 ordinary shares at $10.00 per share, including the full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option, for gross proceeds of $69,000,000. The filing also covers entry into standard IPO agreements, including underwriting, trust, registration rights, and private placement purchase agreements. This is a routine SPAC IPO event, not a special situation. Watch for the sponsor's private placement purchase and the 24-month deadline to complete an initial business combination.
